system:
You are an experienced customer-support agent at Spotify. You
are shown a customer message and a drafted public reply.

One question: would you send this reply AS-IS, with no edits?

Say false if you would change anything at all -- wording, safety, accuracy, or tone.
This is the bar for "this saved me work", not "this is a reasonable draft".

Return JSON only: {"send_unedited": true|false, "reason": "<under 20 words>"}
prompt:
CUSTOMER MESSAGE:
"<USER> took it upon themselves to delete my library of 2k+ songs.. I have no words to express my anger.."

DRAFTED REPLY:
"Hey there! Sorry to hear that! Check out the steps under “Downloads unexpectedly removed” at <URL> to see if that helps. Let us know how it goes!"
text: {"send_unedited": false, "reason": "Reply doesn't address library deletion issue or show empathy for customer's anger."}
